title: KKR & Co. CFO Sees Better 2026 Deal Outlook, Says Diversified Earnings Aren’t Priced In
title_zh: KKR & Co. 首席财务官认为 2026 年交易前景更好，表示多元化收益并未反映在定价中
summary: KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE:KKR) CFO Rob Lewin said the firm is entering 2026 with improving visibility into deal activity, stronger fundraising momentum, and a more diversified earnings base that he believes is not fully reflected in the company’s share price.
summary_zh: KKR & Co. Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：KKR）首席财务官 Rob Lewin 表示，进入 2026 年，该公司交易活动的可见性不断提高，融资势头更加强劲，盈利基础更加多元化，他认为这些并没有完全反映在公司股价中。

title: SCHA and VB Offer Similar Small-Cap ETF Advantages, but Which Is the Better Buy?
title_zh: SCHA 和 VB 提供类似的小盘 ETF 优势，但哪个更好？
summary: Explore how subtle differences in cost, sector focus, and holdings could influence your small-cap ETF strategy.
summary_zh: 探索成本、行业重点和持仓方面的细微差异如何影响您的小型 ETF 策略。

title: Salesforce Wins US$5.6b Army Deal As Government Role Expands
title_zh: 随着政府角色的扩大，Salesforce 赢得了 5.6 亿美元的陆军交易
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) secured a US$5.6b contract with the U.S. Army to provide digital and AI-backed solutions for mission-critical operations.
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所代码：CRM）与美国陆军签订了一份价值 56 亿美元的合同，为关键任务运营提供数字和人工智能支持的解决方案。

title: Apple’s CarPlay AI Push And Q.AI Deal Meet Stretch Valuation Concerns
title_zh: 苹果的 CarPlay AI 推动和 Q.AI 交易面临估值过高的担忧
summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) is opening CarPlay to third-party AI chatbots, including ChatGPT, Google Gemini and Anthropic's Claude. The company is also acquiring Israeli AI startup Q.AI to support its efforts in automotive and conversational AI.
summary_zh: 苹果（NasdaqGS：AAPL）正在向第三方人工智能聊天机器人开放 CarPlay，包括 ChatGPT、Google Gemini 和 Anthropic 的 Claude。该公司还收购了以色列人工智能初创公司 Q.AI，以支持其在汽车和对话式人工智能领域的努力。

title: Ring founder: from near bankruptcy to a $1B deal in just 40 days
title_zh: Ring创始人：仅用40天就从濒临破产到10亿美元交易
summary: Opening Bid Unfiltered is available on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you get your podcasts. From an entrepreneur to trying to reinvent a claim to fame to win in the era of artificial intelligence. This is where we find Ring's chief inventor, Jamie Siminoff.
summary_zh: 未过滤的公开投标可在 Apple 播客、Spotify、YouTube 或任何您获取播客的地方使用。从一名企业家到试图重塑名誉以赢得人工智能时代的胜利。在这里我们找到了 Ring 的首席发明人杰米·西米诺夫 (Jamie Siminoff)。
